issue.title: EAS/dev-client onboarding + prebuild docs
issue.body:
> **Scope note:** This ticket is **verification/validation only, NOT a rewrite**. The EAS/dev-client tooling, preview-build workflow, and onboarding docs were **already built on main** (`eas.json`, `app.config.ts`, `.eas/`, `AGENT_ONBOARDING.md`). Remaining scope: **validate the `preview-build` label loop end-to-end + consolidate onboarding** (no infra rebuild). Assigned to @mattrace-gloo.

### Context

### Current state in baseline

- `docs/AGENT_ONBOARDING.md` updated on main for EAS/preview; `docs/guides/qa-preview-testing.md` exists for non-technical testers.
- `.eas/README.md`, `.eas/workflows/create-production-builds.yml`, and `app.config.ts` (`runtimeVersion: { policy: 'appVersion' }`) are present.
- `.github/workflows/preview-build.yml` + `.github/scripts/eas-resolve-android-build.sh` drive preview builds via the **`preview-build`** PR label; `.fingerprintignore` excludes `docs/**/*` and `.github/**/*` from EAS fingerprint hashing.
- Scripts: `npm start` = `expo start`, `npm run android` = `expo run:android`, `npm run prebuild` = `expo prebuild --clean --platform android`.
- Requires `EXPO_TOKEN` repo secret; preview uses `EXPO_PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL=https://dev.api.fluent.bible`.

### Problems / why

- Onboarding info is spread across `AGENT_ONBOARDING.md`, `.eas/README.md`, and the qa guide; a contributor needs one coherent path from clone → dev-client run → preview build.
- The `preview-build` label loop (trigger → fingerprint match/reuse → bot comment → tester guide) should be validated end-to-end and documented as the canonical flow.

### Target design

- Consolidate a single "Getting started / build & preview" onboarding flow in `docs/AGENT_ONBOARDING.md` linking out to `.eas/README.md` and `docs/guides/qa-preview-testing.md` (avoid duplicated, drifting content).
- Document the dev-client loop: `npm install` → `cp .env.example .env` → `npm run prebuild` → `npm start` + `npm run android` (expo-dev-client).
- Document the preview loop: add `preview-build` label → workflow resolves/builds APK or OTA → bot comments link to the tester guide. Note `EXPO_TOKEN` requirement and the preview API URL.
- Validate the label loop on a test PR and capture any gaps.

### Implementation steps

1. Audit existing docs for overlap/drift; pick canonical homes and cross-link.
2. Write/expand the dev-client quickstart and the preview-build section in `AGENT_ONBOARDING.md`.
3. Run a test PR with the `preview-build` label; confirm the workflow + bot comment + tester guide flow; fix doc gaps.
4. Cross-link the local-only guide (#108).

### Acceptance criteria (verify-only)

- [ ] **Consolidate** existing onboarding into one coherent path (clone → dev-client run → preview build) with no duplicated/contradicting steps — content already exists, just cross-link/dedupe.
- [ ] **Validate** the `preview-build` label loop on a test PR and document it (incl. `EXPO_TOKEN`, preview API URL).
- [ ] **Confirm** commands match current `package.json`; no `@env`/`FLUENT_USER_EMAIL` references.

### Test plan / verification

- Documentation + CI-config validation. Sanity-run gates:

```bash
npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test -- --ci
```

- **No live API required** for CI (tests default the URL via `jest.env.cjs`).
- Preview-build validation is a **manual** check on a labeled test PR (documented manual step).
- Do **not** use `FLUENT_USER_EMAIL`.

### Out of scope

- Local-only/offline guide authoring (#108) — cross-link only.
- Changing the EAS workflow logic itself.

### Links

- Epic: #120
- Related: #108 (local-only docs)

comments.body:
Closing as completed — deliverables already merged to `main`; this ticket was scoped as **verify/consolidate only** (see issue body).

**Shipped via:**
- [#70](https://github.com/eten-tech-foundation/fluent-mobile/pull/70) — EAS profiles, `.eas/README.md`, `preview-build.yml`, `docs/AGENT_ONBOARDING.md` PR preview section, `docs/guides/qa-preview-testing.md`
- [#136](https://github.com/eten-tech-foundation/fluent-mobile/pull/136) — local dev workflow cross-links (#108)
- [#145](https://github.com/eten-tech-foundation/fluent-mobile/pull/145) — quality gates / onboarding doc updates

Acceptance criteria (consolidated onboarding path, preview-build loop documented, commands match `package.json`) are satisfied on `main` in `docs/AGENT_ONBOARDING.md` and `docs/guides/qa-preview-testing.md`.
